title: CloudBurst SMP
description: This is a scripted Minecraft server that is very enjoyable to record with our 3 creators. It has a very good storyline and has a very active community.
body:
Cloudburst SMP is a highly active, scripted Minecraft server built for creators who want consistent content and a great community. We record around 4 times every week, so there’s always something happening and plenty of opportunities to be involved.

Our admins and owners are friendly, supportive, and always ready to help with anything you need. Whether you’re new or experienced, you’ll feel welcomed straight away. Roles are accessible to everyone, so you always have a chance to grow and be part of the story.

The server is based in Australia, but we have players from all over the world, including America, Europe, and South America. No matter where you’re from, there’s a place for you here.

Join Cloudburst SMP and become part of the story.
